articles.headline: Jayda Clark makes 6 3's, scores 23, and Madison Booker returns as No. 6 Texas beats Green Bay 89-57
articles.description: — Jayda Clark hit six 3-pointers and scored 23 points, and Madison Booker had 12 points and nine rebounds after missing Texas' previous game as the sixth-ranked Longhorns beat Green Bay 89-57 on Wednesday night.
